tiles.note: straight at yaw0 runs along z (12 wide x, 10 long z). tee yaw0 = N,E,S open (W closed). corner yaw0 = S+W open. end yaw -90 = W open (yaw0 = S open). yaw = rotation about +Y (three.js), x right, z down/south.
